svg.text: HeartSync DOCK rev E: inside 1:1, stem / puck / watch-stand parts 1:1, side view 1:2
Inside: seen from above with the deck lifted off, front at the bottom. Dashed = underside vents and feet.
PD sink 100 W · fuse + TVS · bucks
FRONT · grey circles = M3 bosses · dashed circles = rubber feet
WATCH STAND post 18 x 14 x 56 (leans back 15°) + holder Ø34
cable channel down the front (dashed) into the base
SIDE VIEW 1:2 (from the right, front left; all parts projected)
Power: one 100 W USB-C adapter → phone 15 + buds 5 + watch 5 W, plus up to 45 W shared by the 3 ports.
The HeartSync charges from one of the USB-C ports (no cradle).
